usage: The word '蒸蝦' is a noun that specifically refers to shrimp prepared by steaming.
You can use '蒸蝦' when ordering food or talking about dishes in a restaurant.
It describes a particular cooking method, so it is often used with cooking verbs like 'eat', 'make', or 'order'.
'蒸蝦' can also be part of a dish name or menu item in a seafood restaurant.
Since it is countable, you can say '一份蒸蝦' (one portion of steamed shrimp) or '幾隻蒸蝦' (a few steamed shrimps).
